reports.description: The list of reports. Each report corresponds to a table within the schema to which connector will sync the data.

advertisers.description: The list of advertisers to include into a sync. This parameter only takes effect when `config_method` is set to `CREATE_NEW`.

config_method.description: The report configuration method. Specifies whether a new configuration is defined manually or an existing configuration is reused. The default value is `CREATE_NEW`.

dimensions.description:
The report dimensions (filters) to include into a sync. The dimension names are provided in the API format. This is a required parameter when `config_method` is set to `CREATE_NEW`.
NOTE: At least one of the following date dimensions must be included for report data aggregation: `FILTER_DATE` (daily), `FILTER_WEEK` (weekly), or `FILTER_MONTH` (monthly).

metrics.description: The report metrics to include into a sync. The metric names are provided in the API format. This is a required parameter when `config_method` is set to `CREATE_NEW`.

partners.description: The list of partners to include into a sync. This parameter only takes effect when `config_method` is set to `CREATE_NEW`.

query_id.description: The ID of the query whose configuration you want to reuse. This is a required parameter when `config_method` is set to `REUSE_EXISTING`.

report_type.description: The type of the report to create. This is a required parameter when `config_method` is set to `CREATE_NEW`.

split_by_advertiser.description: If enabled, the report will be queried separately for each advertiser, and the FILTER_ADVERTISER dimension will be added automatically if not already selected. This parameter only takes effect when `config_method` is set to `CREATE_NEW`. The default value is `false`.

table_name.description: The table name within the schema to which connector will sync the data of the specific report.

update_config_on_each_sync.description: Specifies whether the configuration is updated before each sync or only when the connector settings are saved. This parameter only takes effect when `config_method` is set to `REUSE_EXISTING`. The default value is `true`.

items.description: The list of reports. Each report corresponds to a table within the schema to which connector will sync the data.

timeframe_months.description:
Number of months' worth of reporting data you'd like to include in your initial sync. A change of this value will trigger a re-sync for enabled reports during the next connector sync.
NOTE: The more months of reporting data you sync, the longer your initial sync will take.

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your Google Display & Video 360 client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your Google Display & Video 360 client application.

refresh_token.description: The long-lived `Refresh token` along with the `client_id` and `client_secret` parameters carry the information necessary to get a new access token for API resources.
